discourse.excerpt: The real source of peace is within every individual and it is this inner peace that can confer real joy.
discourse.theme: Real peace is found within, not outside — through equal-mindedness in pleasure and pain, praise and blame.
discourse.title: The quest for peace

reflection: Swami teaches that real peace is not found outside — it swells from within, through equal-mindedness in pleasure and pain, praise and blame. Today, when praise or criticism comes, pause before reacting and keep your peace intact; then radiate a little happiness around you. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 9 Dec 1985)
seva_nudge: Carry peace into one tense conversation today — listen fully before answering, and leave the other person calmer than you found them.

video.title: The Way To True Peace And Happiness | Dr Narendranath Reddy | Shikshavalli Anandavalli & Bhriguvalli
